So… which multivitamin should you choose?

When you zoom out across all of these comparisons, a pattern shows up pretty clearly:

  • Clinical & premium brands like Pure Encapsulations and Thorne pack in activated Bs, chelated minerals, and specialty compounds. They’re great products – but you pay a serious premium for every serving.
  • Big-box basics like One A Day and Nature Made keep costs low by sticking to standard vitamins and minerals. They do the job on paper, but you’re not getting much support beyond “generic multivitamin.” No herbs, no immune blend, no antioxidant fruit stack.
  • High-octane formulas like Legion and Nutricost crank up doses (especially B-vitamins) and lean into performance or “test” marketing. They can make sense if you really want that kind of intensity, but they’re not necessarily built as calm, everyday health foundations.

Guys Goals was built to sit in a different lane.

We’re not trying to out-lab Thorne or undercut dollar-per-pill drugstore brands. Instead, our Complete Multivitamin is designed to be a realistic daily base for guys:

  • Men’s health support from saw palmetto and nettle – ingredients most mainstream multis skip.
  • Immune support from echinacea, beta glucan, spirulina, and garlic.
  • Antioxidant & energy support from a full fruit and phytonutrient blend (green tea, hawthorn, bilberry, grape seed, black currant, pomegranate).
  • High, but not insane, B-vitamin levels to support daily energy and metabolism.
  • Simple dosing – 2 capsules a day, not a handful of 8–10.
  • Fair pricing – about $0.30 per serving at the time of writing.

At the end of the day, the “best” multivitamin comes down to what you actually need:

  • If you want clinical micronutrient precision and don’t mind paying for it, brands like Thorne and Pure Encapsulations make sense.
  • If you just want the cheapest generic multi, One A Day and Nature Made will always be around.
  • If you want a men’s multivitamin that actually thinks about men’s health, immunity, and real-world affordability – that’s the gap Guys Goals was created to fill.

Our advice? Pick a multi you’ll actually take every day, not just the one with the fanciest label. If that sounds like Guys Goals, we’d love to be part of your daily routine.

Less money on supplements. More money for your actual goals.
